scientific_question: Can cheap lab and glasshouse evidence reduce expensive field-selection regret under a fixed experimental budget?

scope.reason: The public real-data case does not contain harmonised lab, glasshouse and field measurements for the same candidate set; synthetic truth makes transfer error auditable.

interpretation: Lower-fidelity evidence is valuable only after demonstrating transport to field truth. Under the controlled cost structure, glasshouse evidence passes that gate and reduces field-selection regret. The numerical gains are properties of the explicit synthetic DGP, not empirical claims about any commercial Crop Protection pipeline.
